intro: Uruguay has the best football record of any small country, with two World Cups.

chapters.title: Football
text: Uruguay won Olympic football gold in 1924 and 1928 and the World Cup in 1930 and 1950; the 1950 win in Rio, the 'Maracanazo', shocked Brazil. It has won the Copa América 15 times.

chapters.title: Stars
text: Luis Suárez, Edinson Cavani and Diego Forlán starred in Europe; Forlán was best player at the 2010 World Cup.

keyTerms.meaning: Uruguay's 1950 win in Brazil's Maracanã stadium.
